name: Rianne
source:
"I distinctly ordered that securing the suspect must be the top priority."

Affiliation: Eclipse - Horus Department
Role: Operations Team 1 captain
Ability: Wind manipulation

Rianne is many things to Haesu—savior, mentor, and the closest thing to family she has left. A former pupil of Haesu’s late mother, Rianne took in both Haesu and Dallae during a time of political peril, raising them not as burdens, but as beloved younger siblings.

Her exceptional skill and sharp instincts led to a rapid rise through the ranks. By her early 20s, she had earned the rare title of the Prophet’s exclusive escort—a position of unmatched honor and trust.

Only two people in the world dare call the Prophet by name: Ricky, and Rianne.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/yuri-eclipse/yuri-x-manga-x-visual-noveleclipse/description]Kickstarter[/url]]
